background_image_description: Deep violet-to-purple radial gradient background with nebula-like magenta flares and starry particle specks, brighter glow toward the left-center and a dark vignette around the edges.

nodes.asset_description: Right-side feature image of a black, rounded-corner smartphone with a centered punch-hole front camera. From the screen emerges a cheerful man sitting cross‑legged, giving two thumbs up. He wears a light blue sweatshirt, dark brown pants, green sneakers with white laces, and has a gray laptop on his lap. The phone screen shows a soft sky‑blue gradient. Soft white vapor clouds emanate around the device. Floating 3D social emojis surround the phone: a red heart-like notification with white heart at far right, a yellow wow face at lower right, a blue circular share arrow at mid‑right, and a yellow face with heart eyes near the phone’s left edge. Subtle drop shadow below the phone.

nodes.svg_description: Rounded rectangle button with 12px corner radius, solid fill #FFC73A, subtle soft shadow below.

Contains three equal sections separated by thin vertical dividers (#6e5c8d). Left section has a small white phone handset icon before the text; middle section plain; right section plain.
